This pathway implies a potential role for Methylprednisolone in modulating ATR activity through the E-selectin-Methylconiine axis. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that the observed interactions may be biologically relevant. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the signaling network and underscores the need for a more detailed understanding of the molecular interactions involved.
